changeSet.sql:
-- Удаляем старую таблицу связей (данных нет, сохранять не нужно) DROP TABLE IF EXISTS krrg_employee_profile_skills;
-- Создаём новую таблицу связей с krrg_development_skills CREATE TABLE krrg_employee_profile_skills ( id BIGINT GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY, profile_id BIGINT NOT NULL, skill_id BIGINT NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT uk_profile_skill UNIQUE (profile_id, skill_id), CONSTRAINT fk_profile_skill__profile FOREIGN KEY (profile_id) REFERENCES krrg_employee_profiles(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, CONSTRAINT fk_profile_skill__skill FOREIGN KEY (skill_id) REFERENCES krrg_development_skills(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT ); CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_profile_skill__profile_id ON krrg_employee_profile_skills (profile_id); CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_profile_skill__skill_id ON krrg_employee_profile_skills (skill_id);
